scope: post-certification database-only hardening of legacy SECURITY DEFINER admin diagnostics whose declared admin_session_token parameter was previously ignored
notes: The functions remain browser-callable under their pre-existing ACLs, but SECURITY DEFINER data access now requires the already-declared admin session token to validate.
No active admin token, JWT, push subscription endpoint, push auth/DH material, or other secret is stored in this proof artifact.

The first attempted migration was rejected transactionally by PostgreSQL for a syntax error before any function was changed; the corrected migration is the sole applied production migration at version 20260830001727.
